scope: Clearance retired-worker hold service; not whole CQB or source parity
finding: Fixed first16 rotatedOut service permanently excludes later retired actors after enough casualty/replacement events. Ineligible early rows retain their places and cannot free the prefix.
implementation: Rotate a callback-local roster copy in windows of16 with a job-local cursor. Existing availability/task/operation gates, one-time hold tracking and stranded-worker failure remain unchanged. Later reactivation receives repeated service without erasing ownership.
bounds: At most16 retired-worker examinations per callback; one roster copy and bounded cursor update. No world scan/new worker. Whole-roster array copy cost scales with existing episode roster and has not been measured.

validation.model: Service sequence visits every member of static rosters0/1/16/17/24/33/64 within ceil(N/16) callbacks; not a native movement simulation.

remaining: Physical repeated casualties and safe retired holds
Large roster churn, owner migration and overhead
CQB flow/isolation and retained historical failures
